arbitration: The assigned resolver applies the funded terms and cited evidence only.
buyer_silence: After the funded review window, anyone may finalize payment to the seller if no dispute was opened.
content_availability: The seller must keep the committed delivery available through the review and arbitration windows.
inconclusive: If the resolver does not rule before the funded deadline, both arbitration reserves are returned and principal follows the funded fallback split.
privacy: Terms, hashes, wallet addresses, amounts and public URIs may be visible on-chain.
scope: Buyer acceptance and reasoned dispute for work that cannot be judged by objective JSON evidence rules.
